faq.title: FAQs
faq.answer.1:
YouCam Enhance is an **all-in-one photo enhancer that lets you fix your old, blurry images and low-resolution portrait photos** with the power of smart AI technology. Transform your old damaged photos into HD, ultra-sharp images, and easily enhance the quality of your photos to share with your friends and family in just a few taps!

YouCam Enhance lets you turn everyday photos into high-definition, repair old photos by increasing image quality, restore your blurry images to perfect moments, reduce the noise of grainy photos naturally, and keep image quality for enlarged images without pixelation. Try it out on your old photos and discover the magic of AI photo enhancement now!
faq.question.2: I would like to understand more about the privacy of my photos. Does Perfect Corp. have access to the photos?
faq.answer.2: Photos uploaded to YouCam Enhance are **temporarily** saved in our server and are not made public anywhere else. If you use the **Share** feature, your images could be publicly available depending on how you choose to share your images. All images will be deleted from our server after 7 days, even if you use the share feature.
faq.question.3: Can I use YouCam Enhance for commercial purposes?
faq.answer.3: You may access and use the service and content for personal use only. Perfect Corp. owns all rights, title, and interests, such as all worldwide intellectual property rights in the service and content. You agree not to engage in the commercial use of Perfect Content other than as expressly permitted in Terms of Service. For more information, please refer to our Terms of Service: YouCam Terms of Service
faq.question.4: How can I remove the watermark?
faq.answer.4:
If you do not have a subscription, all photos downloaded from YouCam Enhance Web will have a watermark. Try out a free trial, or get a subscription plan with a YouCam Enhance account to download images without a watermark.

Pro plans in the YouCam Enhance app (currently iOS only) can also remove the watermark.
faq.question.5: What is the maximum resolution of the result?
faq.answer.5: You can upload images with any resolution. The export resolution scales based on our engine which can’t be selected by users. The maximum supported export resolution is 4096*4096.
faq.question.6: What kind of images can I use with YouCam Enhance?
faq.answer.6: For the best results, you can use old, blurry, or low-resolution portrait photos, product images, or landscape pictures. YouCam Enhance is the best photo enhancer to turn your old pictures into ultra-sharp high-resolution images.
faq.question.7: How can I solve this error, “Oops! Might be user input unsupported format, server issue or other unknown issue”?
faq.answer.7: You may have uploaded an unsupported format. Please try again with a supported format: **JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and GIF**. If the problem persists, send the details and screenshots of your issue to: Contact Us
faq.question.8: After clicking the share link why do I see the message, “Invalid link - The link has either expired or is incorrect”?
faq.answer.8:
If you receive this message, either the link is expired or incorrect.

Shared links expire **7 days** after creation.
If the link hasn’t expired, your URL may be incomplete, check the link again to make sure it is complete.
faq.answer.9: Everyone can enjoy the service for free, but all enhanced images will have a watermark. Try out our enhancement tool to see if it meets your expectations. If you are satisfied with the results, you can activate a free trial, or get a subscription plan for the best experience.

faq.question.11: How can I change my subscription plan for YouCam Enhance Web?
faq.answer.11:
To upgrade your plan:
1. Visit YouCam Enhance Web.
2. Log in to your account (Email, Google, Apple, or Facebook)
3. Tap My Account > Account > **Upgrade**
4. Choose your desired upgrade plan.
5. Tap Upgrade

<u>Note:</u>
- You only need to pay the difference.
- Your new subscription plan will replace your old plan and start a new subscription period from the date of upgrade.
- If you want to downgrade your plan, you need to cancel your subscription and choose the new plan you want to purchase. See “How do I cancel my subscription?” for more details.
faq.question.12: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.answer.12:
To cancel your subscription:
1. Visit YouCam Enhance Web.
2. Log in to your account (Email, Google, Apple, or Facebook)
3. Tap My Account > Account > **Cancel the plan**
4. After you cancel your subscription you can still use it until the expiration date.

<u>Note:</u>
- Cancel your subscription **before the billing date** to avoid unwanted charges.
- Subscriptions renew **automatically**.
faq.question.13: Can I transfer my subscription between YouCam Enhance Web and YouCam Enhance app?
faq.answer.13: No, it is not possible to transfer your subscription from one to the other. Subscriptions to Web and the mobile app are different services and run on separate platforms. To change from YouCam Enhance app to YouCam Enhance Web: - Cancel your app subscription to stop automatic renewal (you can still enjoy your subscription until the expiration date). - Purchase a new subscription on YouCam Enhance Web. To learn more, refer to Apple's policy: See or cancel your subscriptions. To change from YouCam Enhance Web to YouCam Enhance app: - Cancel your Web subscription to stop automatic renewal (you can still enjoy your subscription until the expiration date). - Purchase a new subscription on the YouCam Enhance app. To learn more about canceling subscriptions, please see “How do I cancel my subscription?”
faq.question.14: I can’t log in with my login details
faq.answer.14: For accounts created by **email**, confirm that you entered the correct email address and password. If you are not sure, or have forgotten your password, please click reset password and follow the instructions. After your password has been reset, please log in to YouCam Enhance Web with your new password. For accounts created using **Google, Apple, or Facebook**, select the corresponding method to log in. Please note that creating YouCam Enhance accounts using different sign-up methods are registered as **different accounts** and cannot be connected, even if those accounts are linked to the same email address.
faq.question.15: How can I change my YouCam Enhance account password?
faq.answer.15: To change a password for an account created by email, please click reset password and follow the instructions. After your password has changed, please log in to YouCam Enhance Web with your new password.
faq.question.16: How can I delete my account?
faq.answer.16:
To delete your YouCam Enhance account:
1. Log in > Tap My Account > Account > **Delete account**
2. When you receive the email to delete your account, open it and click on the link to delete your account.

<u>Note:</u>
- If your YouCam Enhance account does not have a confirmed email address, you need to add an email address and confirm it before deleting the account.
- All data associated with your account will be deleted permanently.

image.video.template.upload.guideline.pe: Best Result Tips for Person Photos
Use a clear, well-lit photo with the face fully visible
Make sure only one person is in the frame
Face the camera directly with a neutral expression
Avoid blurry, dark, or low-resolution photos
Avoid photos with multiple people or a partially cropped face
Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, or objects covering the face
Best Result Tips for Pet Photos
Use a clear, well-lit photo with your pet fully visible
Make sure only one pet is in the frame
Capture your pet facing the camera
Avoid blurry, dark, or low-resolution photos
Avoid photos with multiple pets or a cropped body
Avoid photos where your pet is far away or partially hidden
